annotations.title: Read the history of permission changes

description: What changed in who may do what in an app, newest first: role defined, renamed or deleted (with who lost it), a role granted or revoked, the identity board set or cleared, a board policy set or deleted. Each change has when (at), who made it (by), the role, board or user it is about, and the value before and after. The server keeps it 180 days. A role that comes from the people board (set_policy_identity) changes by editing that row, and that change is in the row's history (get_item_history), not here. Requires organization owner or admin.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

before.description: ISO 8601 time: only changes older than it (the at of the last change of the previous page)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: get_permission_history
